watch.en: Skim off the fat and impurities that rise to the surface.
watch.de: Fett und Trübstoffe abschöpfen, die an die Oberfläche steigen.

why.en: Left in, they may make the liquid cloudy.
why.de: Bleiben sie darin, kann die Flüssigkeit trüb werden.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.1 Light Stocks, section Skim the Stock Frequently
sources.sentence: A stock should be skimmed often to remove the fat and impurities that rise to the surface during cooking.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.1 Light Stocks, section Skim the Stock Frequently
sources.sentence: If they are not removed, they may make the stock cloudy.
